 JUDGMENT

The PI, Rajagopalanagar Police Station, Bangalore City, has filed charge sheet against accused persons for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 313 r/w.34 of IPC.
2.

The brief story of the prosecution case is as under:-
The marriage between the accused No.1 and complainant/victim was performed on 29.03.2018.
At the time of marriage, accused persons received 300 grams gold ornaments from the parents of complainant.

After marriage, they started their new marital life in the house bearing No.700/4, 4th cross, Lakshmana Nagar,
Hegganahalli Cross, Siddeshwara village, Gopal Post, Lakvalli Hobli, Tharikere Taluk, Bengaluru.
Such being the case, the accused persons started to harass the complainant by teasing she does not know cooking and abused in filthy language and harassed to give divorce.
So also, against to the will of the complainant, forced her to consume the pills and abort the fetus.

Thereafter the accused persons continuously harassed the complainant physically and mentally to bring additional dowry of Rs.10 lakhs from her parental house and thereby committed the above said offences.
3. The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the concerned ACMM., Bangalore.
The learned Magistrate has took cognizance of the offences and committed the case to the Sessions Court by complying Sec.207 of Cr.P.C. after furnishing copy of charge sheet to the accused persons.

The same was numbered as SC No.2187/2022.
4.
The prosecution has examined eight witnesses as PW.1 to PW.8 and got exhibited documents at Ex.P1 to P10.
On the basis of the evidence of the witnesses, the learned PP has given up C.W.9.
The court has issued summons, warrant and proclamation against C.W.7, C.W.10, C.W.12.

Inspite of issue of summons, warrant and proclamation, the police failed to execute warrant and produce them before the court to record their evidence, as such the prayer of the learned PP was rejected and the witnesses C.W.7, C.W.10, C.W.12 were dropped.
However liberty has been given to the prosecution for examination of the said witnesses, if the said witnesses brought before the court by the concerned police before conclusion of trial.
5. After completion of prosecution side evidence, this Court has recorded the statements of accused persons, as provided U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused persons have denied incriminating evidence present against them and not claimed any defense evidence nor submitted anything to the Court.
The accused persons have complied application u/s.437A of Cr.PC by executing personal bonds and surety bonds.

sentences.text: 6. Heard the arguments on both sides and perused the materials on record.

7. The following points that arises for consideration of this court:
1. Whether the prosecution proves that the marriage between the accused No.1 and complainant/victim was performed on 29.03.2018 and accused persons received 300 grams gold ornaments from the parents of complainant, after marriage, they started to reside in the house No.700/4, 4th cross, Lakshmana Nagar, Hegganahalli Cross,
Siddeshwara village, Gopal Post, Lakvalli Hobli, Tharikere Taluk, Bengaluru, the accused persons started to harass the complainant by teasing she does not know to cook and abused in filthy language and harassed to give divorce and to bring additional dowry of Rs.10 lakhs from her parental house and thereby committed the offence punishable under Section 498(A) of IPC?

2. Whether the prosecution proves that against to the will of the complainant, the accused persons have forced her to consume the pills and abort the fetus and thereby accused persons have committed the offence punishable U/s.313 r/w Sec.34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860?
3. What order?

8. This Court has answered the above above points are as under:
 Point No.1: In the Negative  Point No.2: In the Negative  Point No.3:

As per final order  for the following:
 R E A S O N S 9.
Points Nos.1 and 2: These points are taken up together as they are related to each other and to avoid repetition in the discussion.
The prosecution has got marked important documents complaint and Mahazar at Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 respectively through the complainant.
The recitals of the complainant and charge sheet clearly reveals that accused persons at the time of marriage received gold ornaments from the parents of the complainant.
After marriage of complainant and accused No.1, they started to reside at Hegganahalli cross.

After sometime of the marriage, the accused persons started to harass the complainant for additional dowry and abused her not knowing the cooking and demanded additional dowry of Rs.10 lakhs and also forced her to consume abortion pills and due to which the victim has got aborted.
To prove the said allegations, the prime witness of the prosecution the complainant by name Ashwini examined as P.W.1.

The evidence of P.W.1 reveals that she has Rajagopalnagar Ps vs A1 Naveen S on 24 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46522907/
3 written the complaint on the say of her friends though the accused persons not abused her in filthy language nor demanded for dowry and also accused persons never received dowry and never forced her to consume abortion pills.

sentences.text: The said piece of evidence given by the complainant completely demolish the story of the prosecution.
The said witness clearly deposed about marriage with accused No.1.
Further evidence shows that they are leading happy marital life alongwith other accused persons.
The police have taken her signatures even to the Mahazar at police station.
Perhaps she does not know the contents of either complaint Ex.P.1 nor Mahazar Ex.P.2.
So also, the parents of the victim by name Venkatesh and Indramma have been examined as P.W.6 and PW.7.
The evidence of P.W.6 and P.W.7 clearly shows that they have not given any dowry at the time of marriage between the complainant and accused No.1.
The further evidence discloses that both complainant and accused persons living happily.

The accused persons never tortured the complainant physically or mentally by abusing in filthy language and not demanded further dowry and also never forced her to consume abortion pills so that she got aborted.
However, the evidence of P.W.1, P.W.6 and P.W.7 clearly shows that she had delivered a baby girl and leading happy marital life.

10. It is necessary to note that the brothers of the complainant by name Arun Kumar, Dinesh and Sathish examined as P.W.2 to P.W.4 specifically deposed before the the court about the marriage between the accused No.1 and their sister i.e. complainant.
It is the say of the said witness that the accused persons never demanded dowry at any time nor harassed the complainant and at any time never forced her to consume abortion pills.
Such being the case, the learned PP has treated all the family members i.e. P.W.1 to P.W.4, P.W.6 and P.W.7 as hostile and cross-examined with the permission of the court.

Though the learned PP has made sincere efforts to elicit worthful evidence according to the recital of the complaint and their respective statements, but failed to get any useful evidence to believe that the accused persons have committed the alleged offence.
As such, the evidence of P.W.1, P.W.4, P.W.6 and P.W.7 not at all helpful to prove the allegations against the accused.
11. It is obvious to note that the neighbour by name Shashikala examined as P.W.5.
The evidence given by the said witness is also not in accordance with her statement.
The said witness being the neighbour never deposed anything against the accused persons.

According to the said witness,
accused persons and complainant were living happily and she never come across any sort of harassment either physically or mentally given to the complainant.
The brother of the victim/complainant by name Sathish and neighbour Shashikala also being the signatories to the mahazar marked at Ex.P.2.
The said witness though identified their signatures present on the panchanama Ex.P.2, but never supported about the conducting of mahazar by the IO at the place of alleged incident.
As such, as already discussed above, the witness P.W.4 and P.W.5 after treating them as hostile suggested about the allegations made against the accused by the victim and also related to the mahazar.
The said witness have straight away denied the suggestions instead of supporting the case of prosecution.
As such none of the evidence of the independent witnesses not helpful for the prosecution to prove the guilt against the accused persons.

12. It is obvious to note that the police officer by name Mr.Rghavendra Upari PSI has given evidence before the court that on 05.04.2021 at 8.00 p.m complainant came to police station and lodged Rajagopalnagar Ps vs A1 Naveen S on 24 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46522907/
4 complaint.

sentences.text: On the basis of the complaint, he has registered FIR vide Cr.No.137/2021 and sent to the court and its copies to it superior officers.
The FIR has been marked at Ex.P.10 through this witness.
The said evidence has completely denied by the advocate for the accused persons.

In this case, the prime police official witness Investigation Officer B.Iyanna Reddy cited as C.W.12 in the charge sheet failed to examine by the prosecution since the concerned police failed to execute either warrant or proclamation and keep him present before the court including the Medical Officer C.W.10 Dr.Vishma H.Shetty to prove the allegations made against these accused persons.

The non-examination of the doctor and Investigation Officer, who carried out entire investigation i.e.
conducting of Mahazar recording of statements, collecting of the medical examination report related to the victim is fatal to the case of the prosecution.
As such, it is very clear the prosecution has completely failed to prove the guilt against the accused.
As such, this court has answered the Point Nos.1 and 2 in the Negative.
13. Point No.3:

In view of answer of this court on points No.1 and 2, this court proceed to pass the following:
O R D E R U/s.235(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused Nos.1 to 3 are hereby acquitted of the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 313 r/w.34 of IPC.
